sources.note: Shure SM58 spec sheet (copy hosted by College of San Mateo, opened and text read): Dimensions 162 mm (6-3/8 in.) L x 51 mm (2 in.) W; connector: three-pin professional audio connector (male XLR type). The model stands upright with the XLR end down: h = 162 mm length, w = d = 51 mm head diameter.
Shure product page (opened): the standard SM58 (no on/off switch); it lists no dimensions, so the size comes from the spec sheet above.
Shure product-DB image, private reference (assets-source/shure-sm58/photos/front.webp): front view, the base is a plain round end, the XLR shell is concentric with the handle axis
Shure product-DB image, private reference (assets-source/shure-sm58/photos/three-quarter-base.webp): 3/4 view from the XLR end: three male pins in a shell centred on the handle axis

out-xlr: the catalog has one port, the male XLR. It sits on the bottom (base) face at its centre (x = w/2 = 25.5, y = d/2 = 25.5 from the io edge). Centred by geometry from the photos, no drawing gives it, so the confidence is photo. openingMm is left out on purpose: the inner diameter of the male shell is not published on any page opened. The catalog lists no controls for the SM58 (no switch).
